title: Joy Comes Bubbling Up
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Deep down inside a happy well
There's joy so cool and bright;
Heavenly Father put it there
For you to draw tonight.

[Chorus]
So pull the rope and draw it up,
And feel it splash and shine;
His joy comes bubbling up for you,
And it is yours and mine.

[Verse 2]
When you remember all the good
That He has done for you,
Your heart fills up like water does
And spills right over too.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Isaiah sang, "Go tell them all
The good things He has done!"
And when you give your joy away
It grows for everyone.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
The well is full, so rest your head,
It never will run low;
And when the morning comes again
There's more joy there, I know.

[Chorus]
mood: Bubbling music. A light, buoyant strum that bounces gently under the voice, like water rising in small bright steps and spilling over the rim of a pail, never hurried. A softly strummed ukulele carries the lift with a quiet upright bass walking underneath, and a few high plucked notes sparkle at the end of each line, the way drops catch the light. It is glad from the first bar, opens a little wider in every chorus, and eases down to a slow, contented sway for the last verse.
